annotations.title: Compare family members' running periods side by side

description: Family view for 2–6 linked people (for example wife, husband, children, parents). For each person: current mahadasha and antardasha with dates, upcoming period changes, Sade Sati / Ashtama Shani status, and the windows when two or more members are under Saturn pressure together. Use it when a question involves the whole family. It reports dated overlaps only and never treats one chart as the cause of another person's events.

place.description: Town or village; "<village>, near <town>" is accepted

relation.description: How this person relates to the one asking, e.g. self, husband, wife, son, daughter, mother
